title: Represent single-owner projection and worker custody directly
evidence: LoadedCasProjection wraps a required lease in Option solely for take-plus-expect consuming methods and a Drop that only drops that lease. NativeLineageRecoveryWork similarly wraps attempt/decision/execution while its Drop only drops attempt. ProjectionWorkerPermit owns the sole never-cloned Arc<ProjectionWorkerAdmission>; committed_steering_worker is mutated only through &mut self.
proposal: Store required lease/work fields directly, remove redundant wrapper Drop bodies and destructure consuming methods. Fold worker admission fields into ProjectionWorkerPermit, use an ordinary committed bool, and move the unchanged accounting/wake Drop to the permit.
required_contract_changes: None intended. Preserve current owner field drop order, once-only release and gate/capacity notifications. Keep Option fields on permit pairs and returning session guards: those owners actually take components separately or transfer them in Drop.

verification: Not run; observational audit only. Existing all-role acquisition/drop permutations, pair atomicity, reserve and provisional steering wake tests; review parked-work return and every consuming projection conversion.

title: A readiness scan drops commandless routes' retained continuation
evidence: At native_lineage_recovery.rs:548 the tuple (state.command, state.continuation.take()) evaluates take even when command is None. The failed pattern then continues, dropping a waiting route's decision and parked execution custody. Another ready route triggers this scan; HashMap iteration decides whether waiting routes are damaged first. The coalesced test submits BOTH commands and does not cover an uncommanded peer.
proposal: Check command readiness before taking continuation under the same route lock. Retain the command when continuation is unavailable. Add a deterministic waiting-route-plus-ready-route test that submits the waiting route afterward and proves its exact retained turn still runs.
required_contract_changes: Restores the existing retained exact-decision/turn contract; no new behavior authority is needed. This is a correctness repair, not a line-saving proposal.

estimated_net_lines.basis: Zero savings; defect isolated from AX-005 owner representation.

verification: Not run; observational audit only. Focused two-route deterministic readiness/custody test and existing scheduler cancellation/disposal/coalescing tests.

title: Failed durable compaction admission leaves the installed local command owner
evidence: Both admission methods install local state at lines 44/112 and immediately use require_committed_command(...)? at lines 45/113. A subsequent admission sees retained local state and command drain can remain held until explicit disposal.
proposal: Handle the command outcome explicitly and release/remove the exact installed local owner on definitive nondispatch admission failure; preserve typed committed-later-failure/indeterminate custody and persistent failure handling. Cover this at the admission boundary before extracting AX-001.

title: Partial service construction lacks complete explicit worker disposition
evidence: Compaction constructor accumulates JoinHandles in a local Vec and uses ? on later thread spawn, so earlier handles are dropped on failure. Service construction starts the persistent failure owner, then compaction, then scheduler with ? exits and no explicit joining of earlier successful owners. Existing clean shutdown join tests cover fully constructed owners, not these failure paths.
proposal: Treat as required initial-start/candidate disposition work in the active rework, with an owning construction guard that cancels startup and explicitly joins every started child before returning failure. Do not claim a new simplification or delete initial-start gating.
required_contract_changes: Existing authority already requires explicit terminal ownership and failed-candidate disposition; reconcile with the active rework and historical preflight gap before implementation.

estimated_net_lines.basis: Mandatory rework gap, not new audit savings. No tests, source or plan were changed.

verification: Not run; observational audit only. Partial spawn/failure injection at every construction step; assert cancellation, all joins, provider disposal and no home/worker ownership left.
